messages:
Avery: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — posting links to the RCAs and action items so we can keep momentum. RCA: https://redwood.app/rca/INC-2026-214 (runtime spike) and https://redwood.app/rca/INC-2026-215 (auth cache fail).
Samir: thanks! can we get a one-line summary of primary root cause for each?
Avery: INC-214: autoscaler + kernel OOM under long-tail seqs. INC-215: token-cache invalidation race after config deploy. short mitigation: pin older cache rollouts and bump oom score adjustment.
Tanya: who's owning the autoscaler tuning changes? need rollout window and rollback plan.
Leon: I'll own autoscaler tuning. planning a canary on dedicated for next Wed 02:00-04:00 PT. will update runbook with steps + rollback command. SGTM :thumbsup:
Priya: I can take the postmortem writeups and add a regression test for the auth cache invalidation. ETA EOW.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled by Leon for 2026-04-01T09:00Z. /deploy status: queued
Samir: Leon, please add the exact k8s manifests to the PR so eng-infra can review; tagging @eng-infra.
Leon: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/456 — will add manifests and load test notes.
Tanya: Action items (brief):
  1) Leon — autoscaler change + canary (due next Wed)
  2) Priya — regression test & RCA doc update (due EOW)
  3) Avery — customer comms + share in #customer-success (due in 2 days)
Maya: I'll add an alert for KV cache miss rate > 5% and a dashboard tile for tail latency. will link dashboard in the tracker.
Priya: also need access logs for auth service for the incident window — @Security can you pull those and confirm retention window?
Security: Security team: on it. pulling logs now, ETA ~24h. will DM results and drop a secure link.
Avery: Thanks all. Please add 'owner' labels in the action tracker: https://notion.redwood.com/actions/INC-2026-214. I'll follow up after the canary with a short sync.
Samir: SGTM. tagging this for leadership review in tomorrow's standup. :eyes:
Tanya: Small ask — Leon, please include expected QPS and memory numbers in the PR so we can run capacity sims.
Leon: noted. capacity sims will be uploaded to the PR by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: final note — let's add a short eval in Optimize to catch regressions on long-tail sequences. I'll open a ticket.
Maya: :thumbsup:
Avery: closing loop — will add all links & timelines here once PRs/docs are live.
